senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; פָּקַד)appointed to examine, officer, commissioner.—Pl. פְּקִידִים.
units: <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 42:1">Pesik. R. s. 42</cite> [read:] <he>הרבה פ׳ יש יש שנתפקד וכ׳</he> there are various kinds of commissioners (of the Lord), some are appointed &c., v. <cite ref="Q01449"><he>פָּקַד</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 14:18">Num. R. s. 14</cite> <he>וכבשים כנגד פ׳</he> and lambs were offered (<cite ref="Numbers 7:83">Num. VII, 83</cite>) in behalf of the officers; a. e.
